text: なつになると　ぜんぶ　ぬけおちるが　いっしゅうかんで　もとどおりになる。

structure.jp: ぜんぶ　ぬけおちるが

structure.en: it goes back to how it was

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that always follows'. なつになると = 'when summer comes'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: になる after a word means 'to become' that thing. なつになる = 'it becomes summer'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が right after a verb at the end of a sentence part means 'but'. ぬけおちるが = 'it falls out, but'.
